headers.title: Headers and constants
headers.text: The site as Referer on every picture; LIST_PATH is the directory the home page linked to (/manga/, /series/ or /komik/), COVER_ATTR the image attribute that held a real address.

getPopular.title: Popular
getPopular.text: Loads /LIST_PATH/?page=N&order=popular and reads the .bsx cards: the card link, its title attribute or .tt, the cover image.

getLatest.title: Latest
getLatest.text: The same directory ordered by update.

getDetails.title: Title page
getDetails.text: h1.entry-title, the cover in .thumb img, the summary in .entry-content, author and status from the info rows, genres from .mgen a.

getChapterList.title: Chapters
getChapterList.text: #chapterlist li rows on the title page: the link, .chapternum as title and number, .chapterdate as the date.

getPageList.title: Pages
getPageList.text: Reads the picture list from the ts_reader.run({...}) script of the chapter page; falls back to the #readerarea images when the script is missing.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.text: One request with the site as Referer, the shared .bsx card parser, absolute addresses, the cover attribute chain and the first number of a chapter title.
